author: kloderia
quote: the biggest disappointment in gaming history in my opinion, its just total garbage i mean even compared to all the other gta's, theyre all way better than this, this is just a boring cuck simulator, feels so repetitive id rather play a mafia game if i wanted something "like" gta 6, i mean its just terrible i think the only thing that could save it is major changes, a way better release on pc, a LEGENDARY gta 6 online mode to save it, the gta 6 story mode is just so bad and an unfun experience i dont want to spend my time on, it doesnt even feel like gta they couldve done way better with this, even red dead 2 and cyberpunk 2077 feels miles ahead of gta 6
